pr_title: Treat parenthesized power operands as non-simple

issue_context.title: Formatter undocumented deviation: power spacing
issue_context.body:

Black formatting
```python
10 ** (2)
```
Ruff formatting
```python
10**(2)
```
Use Ruff 0.0.289 with line length 100
comments:
Thanks. This should be easy to fix. We need to ensure that both left and right aren't parenthesized (using `is_expression_parenthesized`)

https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/blob/41f0aad7b3e163436d870dd936e0cdd05cf4b80b/crates/ruff_python_formatter/src/expression/binary_like.rs#L364-L366

review_comments: I kept this out of `is_simple_power_expression` to keep that method `const` and trivia-agnostic, but not sure that's correct.
I would prefer it in `is_simple_power_expression`. The loop here is already complicated enough... Keeping it `const` isn't that important as it is a private function anyway.
